g.text: Environment calibration: the same feedback policy with and without history
All 1,296 worlds per map; fixed scripted policy, not native agents or optimal information value.
T1-T2 are ordinary scored tasks; T3-T20 are also shown separately. Zero and adverse task differences are retained.
